profile.reading:
This is a Digital Realty facility at 300 John F. Kennedy Boulevard East, Weehawken, NJ, per mapping data. This session's fetch of Digital Realty's New York metro property list did not surface a matching named/coded property at this specific address, so no operator-confirmed square footage is reported here.

Digital Realty Trust (NYSE: DLR, SEC CIK 1297996), headquartered at 2323 Bryan Street, Dallas, Texas, reported 310 data centers worldwide as of December 31, 2025, 221 wholly owned or consolidated and 89 in unconsolidated joint ventures, about 57.6 million rentable square feet across more than 55 metro markets including 118 US facilities, per its FY2025 Form 10-K filed with the SEC. The company operates as a colocation and wholesale landlord rather than running its own compute, distinguishing it from hyperscaler tenants such as AWS, Google, or Meta, also tracked in this registry.

This building is part of Digital Realty's New York/New Jersey metro footprint, which spans historic Manhattan carrier hotels and a cluster of suburban New Jersey buildings in Clifton and Piscataway Township, coded EWR10 through EWR21 on the company's own metro listing. Digital Realty markets these properties under its PlatformDIGITAL brand, positioning the metro alongside Northern Virginia, Chicago, Dallas, and Silicon Valley, all tracked elsewhere in this registry, as core hubs in its global interconnection and colocation platform. Weehawken sits directly across the Hudson River from midtown Manhattan.

Digital Realty's FY2025 Form 10-K identifies the United States as its largest single national market by both facility count and rentable square footage, discloses portfolio metrics by region and metro rather than by individual building, and this pattern is consistent across every Digital Realty property researched by this registry this session, not specific to this entry.

reading.body:
Digital Realty owns a data center at 300 John F. Kennedy Boulevard East in Weehawken, New Jersey, coded EWR10 as part of its New York/New Jersey metro cluster. The operator does not publish a megawatt IT capacity figure for this building on its property page or in its 2025 Form 10-K, which discloses portfolio metrics by region and metro rather than by individual facility. No operator-confirmed square footage is reported here.

The Weehawken site sits in the New York/New Jersey metro, one of Digital Realty's core hubs in its PlatformDIGITAL colocation platform, spanning Manhattan carrier hotels and suburban New Jersey buildings in Clifton and Piscataway Township. The metro serves financial services and network interconnection tenants in a region with growing regulatory and community attention to large-load data center siting and grid interconnection. Weehawken is directly across the Hudson River from midtown Manhattan, where Con Edison is the primary grid operator, while PSE&G serves most of northern New Jersey.

New Jersey has 48 mapped data center facilities and 5 with published megawatt figures totaling 111.3 MW across the state. This facility's capacity cannot be ranked against those five because it is unpublished. Digital Realty operates 310 data centers globally and 118 in the United States, but as a colocation landlord rather than a compute operator, and does not disclose power consumption by individual property.
